filing.source_excerpt: Item 1.01 Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement On October 27, 2026, First Community Bankshares, Inc. (“First Community”) entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the “Agreement”) with Main Street Financial Services Corp., a West Virginia corporation (“Main Street”), under which First Community will acquire Main Street. Main Street is a bank holding company headquartered in Wooster, Ohio, with total assets of approximately $1.6 billion, total loans of approximately $1.3 billion, total liabilities of approximately $1.5 billion, total deposits of approximately $1.4 billion and total shareholders' equity of approximately $137 million as of September 30, 2026. Main Street is the parent company of Main Street Bank Corp., which operates 21 banking offices across east central Ohio and in the northern panhandle of West Virginia. Pursuant to the terms and conditions set forth in the Agreement, at the effective time of the Merger (the “Effective Time”), Main Street will merge with and into First Community (the “Merger”). Main Street will cease to exist, and First Community will survive and continue to exist as a Virginia corporation. The Agreement further provides that following the Effective Time, Main Street Bank Corp. will merge with and into First Community Bank, a wholly owned subsidiary of First Community (the “Bank Merger”). First Community Bank will survive the Bank Merger and continue to exist as a Virginia banking corporation. At the Effective Time, a current member of the Main Street board of directors will be appointed to the First Community and First Community Bank board of directors. Merger Consideration The Agreement provides that, upon the terms and conditions set forth in the Agreement, at the Effective Time, each share of Main Street common stock, par value $1.00 per share (“Main Street Common Stock”) outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time will be converted into the right to receive 0.6174 shares (the “Exchange Ratio”) of First Community common stock, par value $1.00 per share (“First Community Common Stock”). Holders of Main Street Common Stock will receive cash in lieu of fractional shares. Based on First Community’s 10-day volume-weighted average price of $48.82 as of October 26, 2026, the exchange ratio represents approximately $30.14 per share of Main Street Connon Stock and an aggregate transaction value of approximately $243 million. The Merger is intended to be a tax-free reorganization under Section 368(a) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the “IRC”). Treatment of Main Street Options As of the Effective Time, each option to purchase shares of Main Street Common Stock (each, a “Main Street Stock Option”) that is outstanding and unexercised under the Main Street 2025 Equity Incentive Plan and the Legacy Wayne Share Option Plan (collectively, the “Main Street Stock Plans”) immediately prior to the Effective Time, whether vested or unvested, will be cancelled without any action on the part of the holder or beneficiary thereof, and converted into the right to receive a lump sum cash payment equal to the product of: (i) the excess, if any, of the product of (A) the volume-weighted average of the closing sales price of First Community Common Stock as reported on Nasdaq for the 10 consecutive trading days ending on and including the last trading day immediately preceding the closing date (the “Average Closing Price”) multiplied by (B) the Exchange Ratio, over the applicable exercise price of such Main Street Stock Option; and (ii) the number of shares of Main Street Common Stock subject to such Main Street Stock Option, less any required withholding taxes. Representations and Warranties; Covenants The Agreement contains customary representations and warranties from both First Community and Main Street, and each party has agreed to customary covenants. Main Street has agreed to conduct its business in the ordinary course during the interim period between the execution of the Agreement and the Effective Time. Each party has agreed to call a meeting of its shareholders to consider and vote upon the approval of the Agreement and the transactions contemplated thereby and, subject to certain exceptions, for the board of directors of each party to recommend that its shareholders vote in favor of the Agreement and the transactions contemplated thereby. Main Street has also agreed to customary non-solicitation obligations relating to alternative acquisition proposals, subject to certain exceptions. First Community has agreed to file the registration statement on Form S-4 with the SEC within 45 days from the date of the Agreement. Main Street and First Community have also agreed to use their reasonable best efforts to prepare and file all applications, notices and other documents to obtain all necessary consents and approvals for consummation of the transactions contemplated by the Agreement. Closing Conditions The completion of the Merger and the Bank Merger are subject to customary conditions, including (1) receipt of the requisite approval of both First Community’s and Main Street’s shareholders of the Agreement, (2) the admission for listing on the Nasdaq Stock Exchange of the shares of First Community Common Stock to be issued in the Merger, (3) receipt of required regulatory approvals from the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and the Virginia State Corporation Commission Bureau of Financial Institutions and regulatory filings with the West Virginia Division of Financial Institutions, (4) effectiveness of the registration statement on Form S-4 for First Community Common Stock to be issued in the Merger, and (5) the absence of any order, injunction, decree or other legal restraint prohibiting the completion of the Merger, the Bank Merger or any of the other transactions contemplated by the Agreement.
